instruction: Using only the visible OpenStreetMap directions interface, enter Berlin Hauptbahnhof as the starting point and Brandenburg Gate, Berlin as the destination, selecting the appropriate visible place suggestions when offered. Switch the routing profile to bicycle or cycling, calculate the route, and report the displayed route distance, estimated travel time, and visible routing profile name. You must fill both endpoints, choose the cycling profile, and calculate the route through the UI; do not answer from prior knowledge.
